name: Archival Documentary
description: The prestige history-documentary look: a dark archive desk under a lamp where a slow Ken Burns camera drifts across sepia photographs with corner mounts, typewritten memos with redaction bars and stamps, newspaper front pages, parchment maps with routes inking between places, red-string evidence boards, handwritten letters, ledgers and film strips. Elegant serif lower-thirds, typed date stamps, lamp flicker, dust and film grain. For history, biography, true crime and investigative storytelling.
